description: A simple Minecraft mod that allows players to replace broken blocks with the block in their hand/offhand.

mods.name: SimpleSwap
mods.description:
Making decisions is hard. SimpleSwap lets you swap blocks fast and easily!

This mod may be considered cheating to some server owners. Use at your own discretion.

releases.notes:
![Simple Swap](https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/SimpleSwap/blob/master/assets/fulllogo-highres.png?raw=true)
> The default Simple Swap key is Left Alt. Hold it down while breaking blocks to have the block in your hand/offhand automatically be placed.
- Ported to 1.21.9

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PoeticRainbow/SimpleSwap/compare/1.0+1.21.4...1.0+1.21.9
